labels.comments: Tammy was great with communication. Her airbnb is just what my granddaughter and I needed for sleeping over in Toronto. Very close to Danforth Music Hall. Clean and easy to find.

We had a wonderful one-month stay at Leroy and Michelle's place! The property was just as clean and tidy as it appeared in the pictures. Leroy and Michelle were incredibly accommodating hosts, making us feel right at home during my extended stay. We wouldn't hesitate to stay with them again in the future. Thanks for a great experience!
Sergio and Andrea are fantastic host who go out of their way to make their guest feel comfortable and at home.

Arman was just the most outstanding host — responsive to all of our needs.
This is a wonderful, spacious house that can accommodate far more than the 4 people we brought.
The house is in a truly quiet, residential neighborhood only an 8 minute walk to Eglinton with its coffee shops and bakeries.
We definitely would consider returning.

The condo was in a great location and very nice, just like the photos. The host was very accommodating, responsive, and provided simple and clear instructions for check in and check out. Would highly recommend staying here!
Great place! We stayed here for a month and really enjoyed it. Host was responsive and the location was super convenient!

I had so a easy going time here. There is so much to do whether its going to the board walk or just being a tourist with it being so closely located to things like the CN tower, Rogers center, Ripleys, etc. The place was very clean and had everything you needed. I definitely wish I stayed more than a single night. This is a great airbnb to live out of for a few weeks. Its also very cute aesthetically and you can see that there is a lot of thought and care into making this a comfortable space to anyone travelling down. It is also nice to know that they can be pet friendly if need be. Owners were very responsive and proactive. Very happy with this stay

Everything was great! It is a big and spacious apartment in the basement of Henry’s house. Good facilities in the kitchen and a big plus with the washer and dryer. The neighborhood is really nice and beautiful with the victorian houses, very calm and peaceful. You can walk into downtown and the other areas of the city, but it takes about an hour - so if you’re not a big walker, it’s nice to take note of this. Henry was very good at responding to our questions and was always ready to help if anything was needed. We can definetely recomned this place, would come back!

A beautiful home close to lots of amenities and great transport links. Very peaceful, lovely inside and outside spaces… amazing contemporary art and very beautifully furnished and fitted.  The host was a lovely lady and very responsive.

Trinity’s place was just what we were looking for - central, affordable, clean, and functional. Communication was quick, and the instructions were clear. Listing is accurate to the photos and description, I would definitely stay here again!

I completely recommend this location. Ben was super responsive, provided clear and detailed instructions for getting in and using the place. It was very quiet and clean. I wholeheartedly recommend this bnb.
Clean. In-suite laundry a huge plus. Good view of the water and Toronto islands. Photos or video of which parking garage to use would be helpful.
I enjoyed my stay at this airbnb. Had no problems, host was very helpful. I found navigating the area was easy. Would recommend 💯

This is a great spot! The space is very modern and clean. Having access to the outdoor space was great for our family to hang out. The beds were very comfortable and it was great having a washer and dryer. We felt safe and the neighborhood is very quiet. Will stay here again!

Fantastic place. Walking distant to the entertainment district. David was excellent. He was responsive and accommodating.
A excellent stay.

Demetrios's place had all the basics for our stay. I was there just for one night but would go back if I need to be in Scarborough.  Quiet neighborhood and it felt like a safe area. he was very responsive and the room was very clean.

Alisa's place was nice. King St is a bit busy but the apartment is very quiet. The place was decently equiped. Small stuff could be addressed that were somewhat inconvenient like small TV, small trash cans, and lack of a nightstand. I'm sure they'll be addressed.

The place was great, perfect location for enjoying Toronto.  Many things to do nearby, including shopping mall.  Host is very communicative and understanding of the visitor's request, even when I requested last minute changes.

Great location, many excellent restaurants in easy walking distance. Exactly as advertised and pictured, this is a nice, clean, stylish place. The parking spot is very useful in this bustling neighborhood. Hosts are great and accommodating. Highly recommended!
Very well kept home, surprisingly very spacious ground floor. On arrival the house smelled very clean. Would recommend to anyone.
